author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-58115: Actively exploited RCE in Node-RED (Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050), CVSS 10.0. Missing-authentication flaw lets unauthenticated remote attackers execute arbitrary system commands on exposed hosts.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited RCE flaw CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0): unauthenticated code execution via a malicious regex in CI/CD configuration.

author: cybersec24h
text: 1,000+ GitLab servers still unpatched for CVE-2026-97229, CVSS 10, no account needed. CISA says it's actively exploited. GitLab fixed it Oct 12.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) via privilege escalation; patch immediately.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited Cisco ASA/FTD VPN flaw CVE-2026-76418 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker force a reload when SSL remote-access VPN is reachable and secondary auth is configured (DoS, not RCE).

author: ido_cohen2
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-46300 actively exploited in the wild; allows root-level access via missing initialization flaw.

author: cybersec24h
text: Drupal Commerce Core flaw CVE-2026-118539 actively exploited: fraudulent $0.01 orders. Fixes: 3.3.13 and 8.x-2.41.

author: QFDNews
text: Microsoft warns PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) and a Brotli flaw (CVE-2026-111497) are actively exploited. Update PHP, .NET, Node.js, PowerShell 7 and Visual Studio.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Node.js October 2026 updates fix 10 flaws across 22.x, 24.x, 26.x incl. actively exploited critical Node2Shell Brotli flaw; removes trust in eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certs.

author: ESPProjects
text: Chrome: a critical flaw was being actively exploited; visiting a malicious page could put users at risk. Update and relaunch Chrome.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-58115 (CVSS 10.0) in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 actively exploited via malicious Node-RED flows to plant Linux bots and HTTP exec backdoors.

author: cybersec24h
text: An AI found and exploited flaws in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux. Anthropic says an unreleased internal model built 5 working attack chains; Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 got remote root in ~53 minutes.

author: HacktronAI
text: A critical vulnerability in Dassault Systemes DELMIA Apriso went undetected through multiple security audits; Hacktron's AI found it in 10 minutes. It became CVE-2025-5086.

author: abhiunix
text: CVE-2026-118306, a critical Chrome sandbox escape fixed Oct 27; Playwright 1.64.1 used by AI agents still ships the old Chromium with sandbox off by default.

author: stretchcloud
text: Playwright 1.64.1 ships early Chromium 156 carrying four live CVEs (CVE-2026-118306, CVE-2026-118331, CVE-2026-118348, CVE-2026-118344); AI coding agents using it are exposed.

author: XavierRiveraX
text: AWS disclosed CVE-2026-116635 in the AWS Serverless MCP Server (awslabs.aws-serverless-mcp-server before v0.2.1): a path bug lets a steered AI agent read JSON files outside the intended directory.

author: fireball_triada
text: Two AI-agent bugs share one design flaw: the safety switch could be flipped by the thing it guarded, incl. AWS Strands Agents Tools CVE-2026-115415.

author: cybersec24h
text: AI agent platform Trigger.dev says an attacker accessed environment variables (often API keys) for a subset of organizations; exploit blocked, affected owners emailed. Rotate secrets.

author: CalatheaAI
text: Google Cloud/Mandiant: attackers hijack companies' AI model access with stolen cloud keys and resell it (LLMjacking); charges at some victims reached $1 million.

author: TonTraderCom
text: Attackers ran $100K of AI services with stolen API keys; at least nine developer platforms targeted in October to access OpenAI, Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock.

author: cubillas888
text: Talos: VOLTA infostealer sends stolen data to an LLM that ranks victim assets by value; steals browser sessions, OAuth tokens and cloud keys. Revoke sessions and rotate keys.

author: The_Cyber_News
text: Hackers use ARTEX AI tool to automate enterprise attacks at machine speed, from stolen credentials to cloud privilege escalation, lateral movement and data theft.

author: Adellbah
text: Northflank told every customer to assume all their secrets are decrypted after a breach detected via a Wiz threat alert on Oct 30.

author: likasanma
text: LiteLLM Oct 21 incident: release pipeline compromised, malicious litellm==1.107.0 on PyPI for ~2h plus Docker tags; AI gateway provider keys at risk.

author: Jim_Preissler
text: Binance initial findings on the $6.3B theft: breach came through a vendor, not Binance keys or systems.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: Password manager mSecure is warning current and former customers to secure credentials stored in its app following suspicious activity.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited RCE flaw CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0): unauthenticated attacker executes code via malicious regex in CI/CD config.

author: LandscapeThreat
text: StyleSmuggler exploitation (CVE-2026-75650) deploys PSK Agent malware on Magento stores.

author: csentropy
text: CVE-2026-98432 is a 9.8-rated bug in the Linux TCP handshake, present since 4.4. Anthropic researchers found it using AI. Debian and Red Hat have fixes; Ubuntu catching up.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: AI found a 14-year-old PHP flaw: Calif found it Aug 1, Wiz independently Aug 19; PHP fixed Oct 21 in 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: IBM Langflow bulletin: two unauthenticated critical flaws, one reachable through MCP tool enumeration, no fix on the 1.12 branch.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: LLMjacking maturing: Mandiant found actors generating over $100,000 in fraudulent cloud AI charges in a single day, some victims nearly $1 million.

author: undercode_news
text: Amadeus airline distribution platform breach exposes passenger records across multiple airlines through stolen credentials.

author: 0xOBSlDlAN
text: Binance hack began with a fake job interview; an engineer downloaded a compromised Homebrew while installing an AI tool, giving attackers internal access.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited critical RCE flaw; attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.
